cues.en: Welcome to this section on adjusting the attention activations.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到調整注意力活化的章節。

cues.en: Remember that the attention block comprises individual heads, like a few dozen heads, and their goal
cues.zh: 記得，注意力區塊由個別注意力頭組成，例如數十個頭；它們的目標，

cues.en: is to incorporate the context of the preceding tokens into the currently processed tokens, so that
cues.zh: 是將前面 token 的上下文，整合到目前處理的 token，

cues.en: the token embeddings vector can be tugged in a way that facilitates an appropriate and relevant prediction about the next token.
cues.zh: 讓 token 嵌入向量朝有助於適當、相關之下一個 token 預測的方向移動。

cues.en: For that reason, experiments involving causal interventions with attention heads are generally focused
cues.zh: 因此，涉及注意力頭因果干預的實驗，一般會聚焦於

cues.en: on understanding how those interventions impact the ways that the model incorporates context into token embeddings, vectors, and ultimately next token predictions.
cues.zh: 理解這些干預，如何影響模型將上下文納入 token 嵌入向量，乃至最終下一個 token 預測的方式。

cues.en: For example, in this, in the following videos you will learn how to isolate and manipulate individual heads in a transformer block.
cues.zh: 例如，這支與後續影片，會學習如何獨立取出、操作 Transformer 區塊的個別注意力頭。

cues.en: We will replace each head at a time with either zeros or the average of the within head activations.
cues.zh: 每次把一個頭，替換成零，或該頭內活化的平均值。

cues.en: And to access each individual head, I will show you a different hook implanting function so that we
cues.zh: 為了存取個別注意力頭，我會展示不同的 hook 植入函數，讓我們

cues.en: can get the individual attention heads before they are mixed together by the zero linear mixing matrix.
cues.zh: 在它們被 W0 線性混合矩陣混合前，取得個別注意力頭。

cues.en: And then we will measure the impact in a few different ways.
cues.zh: 接著，用幾種不同方式衡量影響。

cues.en: So this video here is a code demo in which I will set up the basic design of the experiment.
cues.zh: 這支影片是程式示範，我會設定實驗的基本設計。

cues.en: I do not actually want to change the individual q or k vectors.

cues.en: Instead, I want to change the attention heads after their adjustments have been calculated.
cues.zh: 而是要在注意力頭已經算出調整後，修改它們。

cues.en: Therefore, I'm going to hook into this C proj layer.
cues.zh: 因此，會掛接這個 c_proj 層。

cues.en: Now the problem with hooking into this layer is that this is the projection from the attention algorithm,
cues.zh: 掛接這一層的問題，是這是注意力演算法的投影，

cues.zh: 而是要攔截輸入，在它透過乘上 W0 矩陣進行

cues.en: So that was this dimension.

cues.en: And then I reshape it back.

cues.en: And then here I send it back out to be processed with the rest of the C proj layer, which basically just means multiplying by the w0 mixing matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡傳回去，交由 c_proj 層其餘部分處理，基本上就是乘上 W0 混合矩陣。
